text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Due to a mix-up... my preferred soft 
water... wasn't delivered.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Therefore—my pre-sleep—routine... Drinking 
plain hot water—also failed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Symboli Kris S wasn't able to 
get very good rest...
